title: Sakana AI to Build Homegrown AI Models to Reduce Dependence on US and China
summary: The Japanese firm Sakana AI is creating proprietary machine learning tools for use in the cyber and defense industries. The company will develop these domestic models from scratch to remove the risks associated with relying on AI technology from the US and China.
